en: A hand-colored early-20th-century postcard showing a broad cobblestone market square lined with two‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs and green shutters. Several people in period clothing are walking or standing in the open square, with trees planted along the center. On the right side is a large building labeled "Rathskeller," suggesting it is part of the town hall complex. The sky is softly tinted blue and peach. Printed captions identify the view as the market square of Dommitzsch.
